scam_families.name: Bank, Card & KYC Impersonation
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: debit card is about to expire
how_it_works: Caller claims to be your bank manager or KYC verification officer.
They invent a false emergency (expired card, blocked account, KYC deadline).
They demand your card numbers, CVV, OTP, or net banking password to 'fix' it.

do_now_steps.title: Hang up the phone immediately
do_now_steps.detail: Do not stay on the line. Legitimate bank staff will never threaten you with instant account suspension.

do_now_steps.title: Call your bank's official number
do_now_steps.detail: Use the toll-free customer support number printed on the back of your debit/credit card or inside your official mobile banking app.

do_now_steps.title: Report to National Cyber Crime Helpline
do_now_steps.detail: Dial 1930 immediately if any financial information was shared.

never_do: Never share any 4 or 6 digit OTP sent to your mobile phone.
Never reveal your CVV (3-digit code on the back of your card) or ATM PIN.
Never install any 'quick support' or remote screen-sharing software.

per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Call your bank immediately to block your debit/credit card, freeze UPI access, and change net-banking passwords.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: File an alert on cybercrime.gov.in and monitor your credit report and bank statements for unauthorized inquiries.
per_chip_actions.sent_money: Call 1930 within the golden hour so law enforcement can coordinate with the receiving bank to freeze the beneficiary account.
per_chip_actions.installed_app: Turn on Airplane Mode immediately, uninstall any unfamiliar app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk), and format the device if needed.
per_chip_actions.clicked_link: Disconnect Wi-Fi/data, clear browser cache, and update all banking credentials from another secure device.

safe_replies: I do not share banking information over the phone. I will visit my branch directly.
Please send an official postal notice or secure in-app message through the banking portal.

scam_families.name: OTP & Account Takeover Trap
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: tell me the four digit otp
how_it_works: Fraudsters trigger a password reset or fund transfer on your account.
They call pretending to be technical support or security verification.
They persuade you to read out the OTP to 'cancel' or 'verify' the transaction.

do_now_steps.title: Never read out or forward the OTP
do_now_steps.detail: An OTP is like a digital signature; sharing it authorizes the scammer to drain funds.

do_now_steps.title: Check your recent SMS alerts
do_now_steps.detail: Read the SMS carefully to see what organization and amount the OTP is actually for.

do_now_steps.title: Block digital access if shared
do_now_steps.detail: Dial 1930 or your bank's emergency lock line immediately.

never_do: Never believe that an OTP is needed to 'receive money' or 'cancel an order'.
Never share OTPs with someone claiming to be customer service.

per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Lock your net banking, UPI apps, and cards immediately. Call 1930 to trigger a freeze request.
per_chip_actions.sent_money: Report the transaction UTR number to 1930 and file a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: Lock your Aadhaar biometrics via mAadhaar app.

safe_replies: OTPs are strictly confidential. I will never share any code over the phone.
I am hanging up now and will verify this in my official account dashboard.

scam_families.name: SIM & Telecom Deactivation Threat
red_flag_phrases: in 23 hours your sim will be closed
how_it_works: An automated or live call claims your mobile number is involved in illegal activity or unpaid KYC.
They threaten that your SIM card will be deactivated within 2 hours or 23 hours.
They demand your Aadhaar number, date of birth, and an OTP to 'reactivate' the line.

do_now_steps.title: Hang up and ignore the ultimatum
do_now_steps.detail: Telecom providers (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL) do not disconnect numbers via automated phone threats.

do_now_steps.title: Check your status in official operator app
do_now_steps.detail: Open MyJio, Airtel Thanks, or Vi app to verify your plan and KYC status securely.

do_now_steps.title: Report the number on Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi)
do_now_steps.detail: Report the fraudulent caller on the government telecom fraud portal.

never_do: Never dial IVR shortcodes (e.g., *21*, *401*) that enable call forwarding.
Never share Aadhaar or OTP with someone claiming to be telecom support.

per_chip_actions.shared_documents: Lock your Aadhaar biometric authentication immediately using the official mAadhaar portal.
per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Check with your telecom provider in person at an official store to ensure no unauthorized SIM swap was requested.
per_chip_actions.clicked_link: Uninstall any third-party APKs downloaded from messages.

safe_replies: I will check my account status in my telecom provider's official app.
If my SIM has an issue, I will visit the authorized store in person with my ID.

scam_families.name: Prize, Lottery & Cashback Lure
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
how_it_works: Caller announces you won a massive lottery, luxury vehicle, or cash reward you never entered.
To release the prize, they instruct you to pay 'GST', 'customs clearance', or 'registration fees'.
Once money is transferred, the caller disappears and demands even higher fees.

do_now_steps.title: Remember: Genuine prizes never require upfront payments
do_now_steps.detail: Any contest demanding a fee or tax advance to release winnings is 100% fraudulent.

do_now_steps.title: Never click claim links or call premium toll numbers
do_now_steps.detail: Scam numbers beginning with 0906 or international codes charge exorbitant rates.

do_now_steps.title: Report suspicious lottery calls
do_now_steps.detail: Submit the number to the Chakshu portal and block the caller.

never_do: Never send money to claim any prize, reward, or lottery.
Never provide bank account details to receive an unexpected large award.

per_chip_actions.sent_money: Dial 1930 immediately with the transaction details and beneficiary UPI ID/account.
per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Lock your net banking and debit cards immediately.

safe_replies: I did not enter any lottery. Deduct any fees from the winnings or cancel the entry.
Do not contact this number again. I am reporting this call to Chakshu.

scam_families.name: Government, Police & 'Digital Arrest' Scam
signature_tactics: Asking you to keep it secret
Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: stay on video call or be arrested
transfer money to rbi verification account
how_it_works: Fraudsters impersonate police, CBI, ED, customs, or court judges on Skype/WhatsApp video.
They display fake badges, uniforms, and forged legal documents claiming a parcel in your name had illegal drugs.
They place you under fake 'digital arrest', forbid you from speaking to family, and demand money transfer for 'RBI verification'.

do_now_steps.title: Hang up and disconnect the video call
do_now_steps.detail: There is NO legal concept of 'Digital Arrest' in Indian or international law. No police or court conducts trials over video calls.

do_now_steps.title: Talk to a family member or trusted friend
do_now_steps.detail: Scammers rely on isolation and fear. Sharing the situation breaks their psychological hold immediately.

do_now_steps.title: Call National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 or Police 112
do_now_steps.detail: Report the imposter numbers, Skype IDs, and payment details to 1930 immediately.

never_do: Never transfer money to any 'safe government escrow' or 'RBI verification account'—no such accounts exist.
Never remain isolated in a room on video call under threat of arrest.
Never hand over your digital signatures, OTPs, or financial statements.

per_chip_actions.sent_money: Call 1930 within minutes. Every minute counts for inter-bank fund recovery.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: File an official police report on cybercrime.gov.in noting that your identity documents were extorted under duress.
per_chip_actions.installed_app: Disconnect all internet connections, boot into safe mode, and remove any remote desktop tools.

safe_replies: There is no legal provision for digital arrest. I am disconnecting and contacting my local police station.
Send an official written summons to my registered physical address.

scam_families.name: Loan, Investment & Part-Time Job Advance-Fee
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: pay processing fee for loan disbursement
how_it_works: Victims are offered guaranteed high-yield investments, instant collateral-free loans, or easy work-from-home tasks.
Early small payouts are given to build false trust.
Large sums of 'processing fees', 'margin deposits', or 'tax clearance' are requested before you can withdraw.

do_now_steps.title: Do not pay any advance fees
do_now_steps.detail: Legitimate RBI-registered banks deduct processing fees from loan disbursement, never upfront via UPI.

do_now_steps.title: Verify RBI registration status
do_now_steps.detail: Check if the lending entity is listed on the official RBI Sachet portal (sachet.rbi.org.in).

do_now_steps.title: Report suspicious Telegram/WhatsApp job groups
do_now_steps.detail: File a report on Chakshu and cybercrime.gov.in.

never_do: Never pay money in advance to secure a job, loan, or investment return.
Never install unofficial lending APKs that ask for contact and photo gallery permissions.

per_chip_actions.sent_money: Dial 1930 with transaction IDs. Collect screenshots of chat history, payment receipts, and group links.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: Monitor your PAN and bank accounts for unauthorized loan applications.

safe_replies: I only take loans from RBI-licensed commercial banks with standard physical documentation.
I do not pay upfront fees for job placements or online tasks.

scam_families.name: Tech Support, Screen Share & 'UPI Upgrade'
signature_tactics: Asking you to install an app or share your screen
how_it_works: Caller claims your computer has malware or your UPI app requires a mandatory security update.
They guide you to install remote access software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk) from Play Store.
They ask you to open your mobile banking app or transfer Re 1, allowing them to capture your MPIN and passwords live on screen.

do_now_steps.title: Turn on Airplane Mode immediately
do_now_steps.detail: Cutting internet access immediately severs the scammer's remote connection to your device.

do_now_steps.title: Uninstall the remote access app
do_now_steps.detail: Remove AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, or any newly installed APKs.

do_now_steps.title: Change banking passwords from another device
do_now_steps.detail: Change your net banking password and UPI PINs from a clean family phone or laptop.

never_do: Never install AnyDesk or TeamViewer on instruction from an unknown caller.
Never open banking apps while screen sharing is active.

per_chip_actions.installed_app: Turn on Airplane Mode, backup important files, uninstall the suspicious apps, or perform a factory reset.
per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Lock your net banking and UPI access immediately via your bank's emergency lock facility.
per_chip_actions.sent_money: Call 1930 to freeze the receiving account.

safe_replies: I do not permit remote screen access to my devices.
I will have my device inspected by an authorized service centre technician.

scam_families.name: Health, Vaccine, Insurance & Welfare Scheme
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
how_it_works: Scammers pose as Ministry of Health, IRDAI, or insurance representatives offering free bonus payouts or policy renewals.
They demand Aadhaar numbers, OTP verification, or advance documentation stamp charges.

do_now_steps.title: Verify only on official government portals
do_now_steps.detail: Check benefits directly on cowin.gov.in, pmjay.gov.in, or your insurance provider's official customer portal.

do_now_steps.title: Never share OTPs for healthcare updates
do_now_steps.detail: Government health and welfare schemes do not require phone OTP verification to release benefits.

do_now_steps.title: Report impersonation on Chakshu
do_now_steps.detail: Report the fraudulent contact number.

never_do: Never pay advance stamp fees to claim lapsed insurance bonuses.
Never share Aadhaar OTPs for unsolicited health scheme calls.

per_chip_actions.shared_documents: Lock your Aadhaar biometric profile in the mAadhaar app.
per_chip_actions.sent_money: Call 1930 immediately to log a financial fraud complaint.

safe_replies: I manage my health policies and government schemes through official portals only.
I will contact my designated insurance agent directly.

scam_families.name: Family Emergency & Relative Impersonation (AI Voice Clone)
signature_tactics: Asking you to keep it secret
Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: your son has been arrested in accident
your daughter is in hospital emergency
don't call your spouse or child
pay hospital deposit to start surgery
how_it_works: Caller claims your child, spouse, or relative is in police custody, injured in a critical accident, or kidnapped.
They may use AI voice cloning or background crying sounds to imitate the relative.
They demand instant money transfer to a third-party UPI account while forbidding you from hanging up.

do_now_steps.title: Hang up and call your relative on their saved number
do_now_steps.detail: Always call back directly on the trusted phone number you have saved in your contacts.

do_now_steps.title: Use a secret family safe word
do_now_steps.detail: Ask a simple question only your actual family member would know (e.g., pet's name, childhood memory).

do_now_steps.title: Call trusted relatives or local police
do_now_steps.detail: If you cannot reach the person, contact their school, workplace, or dial 112 before sending any money.

never_do: Never send money under panic without independently speaking with your relative.
Never stay on the line if the caller demands you not inform other family members.

per_chip_actions.sent_money: Dial 1930 immediately to request an urgent inter-bank freeze on the beneficiary account.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: File an emergency report on cybercrime.gov.in.

safe_replies: I am hanging up now to call my family member directly on their phone.
What is our family safe word? I will not transfer money until verified.

scam_families.name: Threat, Extortion & Video Sextortion
signature_tactics: Asking you to keep it secret
Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
red_flag_phrases: will viral your photos on social media
how_it_works: A video call is initiated by a stranger who strips or plays explicit video, capturing the victim's face in screenshot/recording.
Minutes later, someone posing as police or YouTube executive demands extortion payments to stop public leak.
Paying once leads to endless demands for higher sums.

do_now_steps.title: Do NOT pay any money
do_now_steps.detail: Paying never stops blackmail—it confirms you are compliant and leads to bigger demands.

do_now_steps.title: Screenshot evidence and block the caller
do_now_steps.detail: Save chat logs, phone numbers, payment QR codes, and profiles before blocking.

do_now_steps.title: Report to Cyber Crime 1930 & StopNCII.org
do_now_steps.detail: StopNCII.org creates cryptographic hashes to prevent intimate images from being uploaded across major social platforms.

never_do: Never transfer any extortion money.
Never delete evidence or chats in panic; evidence is vital for law enforcement.
Never suffer in silence—confide in a close friend, counsellor, or helpline.

per_chip_actions.shared_photos: Create protective hashes immediately on StopNCII.org and file a report on cybercrime.gov.in.
per_chip_actions.sent_money: Dial 1930 immediately to attempt recovery and document extortion payments.
per_chip_actions.shared_documents: File an FIR at your local cyber cell or online portal.

safe_replies: I am documenting all communications and filing an immediate complaint with the Cyber Crime Branch.
I do not respond to extortion demands.

scam_families.name: Abusive, Harassing or Intimidating Caller
how_it_works: Caller uses profanity, vulgarity, intimidation, or aggressive threats (often rogue recovery agents or stalkers).
They attempt to humiliate or terrorize the victim into compliance.

do_now_steps.title: Disconnect immediately and block the caller
do_now_steps.detail: Do not engage or argue; toxic callers escalate when they receive emotional reactions.

do_now_steps.title: Enable spam call blocking on your phone
do_now_steps.detail: Use built-in phone spam protection or operator DND registration (TRAI 1909).

do_now_steps.title: Contact Women Helpline (181) or Emergency (112)
do_now_steps.detail: If you face stalking, sexual harassment, or physical threats, reach out for protection.

never_do: Never engage in prolonged arguments with abusive callers.
Never give out your home address or routine.

per_chip_actions.threatened: Call 112 or visit your local police station if you feel physically unsafe.

safe_replies: This call is being recorded and logged with law enforcement. Disconnect immediately.
Any further calls will result in an FIR for criminal intimidation under BNS/IPC.

scam_families.name: Courier, Parcel & Customs Delivery Scam
signature_tactics: Asking for passwords, OTP, or money
how_it_works: Caller or SMS claims a courier in your name is held at customs or couldn't be delivered due to wrong address.
They demand a Rs 5–50 'redelivery fee' via a phishing link, or claim the package has illegal contraband to trigger a police scam.

do_now_steps.title: Check tracking only on the official courier website
do_now_steps.detail: Open the official FedEx, BlueDart, India Post, or DHL app and enter the tracking number yourself.

do_now_steps.title: Never click links to update delivery address
do_now_steps.detail: Phishing links steal card numbers and SMS OTPs under the guise of tiny Re 5 charges.

do_now_steps.title: Report the suspicious message on Chakshu
do_now_steps.detail: Submit the sender number and URL.

never_do: Never pay delivery fees through unsolicited SMS links.
Never believe phone claims that a courier company has placed you under police investigation.

per_chip_actions.clicked_link: Block your card if you entered payment details and clear browser data.
per_chip_actions.shared_otp: Lock your net banking immediately and dial 1930.

safe_replies: I will track my shipments exclusively via the courier's official tracking portal.
I do not process delivery updates through third-party links or phone calls.

scam_families.name: No Scam Indicators Detected
how_it_works: This conversation appears to be a genuine, everyday phone call or message.
No manipulative pressure tactics, authority impersonation, or credential requests were identified.

do_now_steps.title: Keep general phone safety in mind
do_now_steps.detail: Remember the Golden Rule: Real banks and government agencies never ask for passwords or OTPs over a phone call.

never_do: Never share sensitive OTPs or bank credentials, even on seemingly normal calls.
safe_replies: Thank you. Have a great day.

golden_rule: When in doubt, hang up and call back on a number you trust.
